topic.title: Hangman Game
topic.description: The complete polished Hangman game with logo, word list, lives, and ASCII art stages. Combines all previous steps into a fully playable game.

learningNotes.whatILearned: How to assemble multiple concepts — random selection, loops, lists, and conditionals — into a complete working game.
learningNotes.challenges: Handling repeated guesses and keeping the display state consistent across turns.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Add a GUI using tkinter or expand the word list from an external file.

files.description: Complete Hangman game with logo, stages, and word list.
